items.title: New investor, just one question (timing purchases)
items.text:
New investor, just one question (timing purchases)
Hi folks. Finished reading Bogelheads guide to 3 three fund portfolio. I had a question regarding the best strategy for timing. 

Say I invest a lump sum initially. My plan after would be to invest a portion of my weekly check into the portfolio. Im assuming there are fees with every buy. Do I purchase every week, every month, once a quarter? What's the best way? Thank you all for any advice. I want to get into the game which seems scary and just want to do this the best way. Much appreciated.

Wow thank you all for the support!! I thought for sure I was gonna get the "Haze the new guy" routine. Youve all answered my question. A Vanguard account IT IS... And to John's point, I will buy as frequently as possible, when possible. Much respect to all for the quick responses. I'm gonna stick around here.
Potentially, sure, as long as it performed as well as the 3 fund. Wouldnt that approach increase international exposure beyond the recommended balance?
Brown wtf. Fucking watch JJ and TJ get roasted all game then send Smith out with a min left. Holy shit.
"An all out shit fest" may be the best description of the Sixers game as well?

Yeah, because +/- tells a complete story, doesn't it? Embiid was a -17! We should probably cut him by your math? D'Angelo Russell was a -10! He REALLY hurt the Nets today. 

Merely stating I would've liked Smith to play more than 1 min. Which, oh, you then said the same thing. But youre personally attacking because... who knows why?

Getting him comfortable with shooting in game would do something, i think. We've all seen the videos of him shooting and making 3s in the gym. He's extremely uncomfortable shooting in game. I feel it's not that he can't shoot. It's that he wont shoot. How do you overcome that?
Somehow it helps, for sure.
Landry too. They had a younger, more athletic JJ, in the making.

LOLz "you attacked TJ"..."You have an agenda"... Everyone one of your posts is about TJ, but I have an agenda?? This is halarious. What are you, his wife on a burner account?

Actually read my post. I called out Brown. JJ and TJ did what I expect, as a liability on Defense (don't care what you think, that's fact) Nets consistently targeted and exploited them. If you don't see that then no one can help you.  EVERYTHING else you're talking about has nothing to do with anything I said. You don't know my thoughts on those topics at all. 

I'm done responding because you don't read. But if there's one thing I want you to understand it's that if the Sixers win or lose this series, it will have virtually ZERO to do with TJ McConnell.
AI and D Jax in the 1st row... you know Jonah got dat 2nd hand.
POP THAT KORK !!! FTW
The city should be proud of Ben. Love him or hate him, he responded. Not every player does. Triple Double when the pressure was on.

I heard this saying several years back, during flyers playoffs. It goes: In the playoffs, when your team loses, you feel they'll never win again. When your team wins, you feel they'll never lose. 

That may sum up the swing of emotion during the last 3 days.

Game 3. LETS GO!!!
Only misstep of the night Imo
Kork is out there, Sixers didn't even care to pickup his option. But we have a healthy Smith, not dressed. a guy who did enter at the very end of game 1. I'm not seeing the logic on this.
This was absolutely amazing. The Embiid part was my favorite and had me dying. Well done.
One hand on ya
Ennis has single handedly shifted the momentum of this game.
Damn that hurt a bit
I agree with you
Simmons
OMFG
Gentlemen. Once again. Pop that KORK!!

It's gotta be said, when the game was in it's most fragile state, Harris pounded a 3 ball so we could all start breathing again. 

Ben was on another level tonight. 

It's impressive that with Embiid out, Sixers delivered a convincing win 1st game in Brooklyn.
No doubt. When he plays that well the Sixers take the shape of a unicorn.

It definitely says something about their mental toughness. A bunch of nonsense in the press. 1st game in Brooklyn. Then they get the news that Embiid can't go?!? They all step up and deliver. Granted, it's Brooklyn and not Toronto, but a lesser team would've folded.

Ben Simmons comes out Game 2, drops a triple double with Embiid on floor (Bell ringer for the game). Game 3 with no Embiid, has another great game. Following day, media story: Simmons and Embiid can't play together. Sixers should seek trades.

Really incredibly moronic and short sighted.
I think there's alot of fear if they see the sixers again, they will fall. I like the matchup. Would love to see this team get that chance.

King, by your estimate, do you think this team is ready for Toronto? 

They scare the shit out of me.
I hope you're right. I feel like Leonard is pretty choke proof tho at this point. Granted hes only 1 man.

He gets ball. Theres follow through, but I don't think he hits his face. If the scrum doesn't breakout, it's a common foul. BS 

Now can someone tell me why Embiid points at him?? Lol
Ah, I see. He thought it went out of bounds.
And thus, The Joel Challenge, was born.

Spilled milk, I get it, but it wouldve been nice to have given Smith more than an 1 minute of playoff time during the first series. They didnt set him up for success in this instance. I hope he does well.
Very proud of how they have stepped up. Playoffs are about complete games. Gotta bring the same defensive focus and intensity through the 2nd half. Let's go !!
Brown is playing serious minutes with biid butler, Harris on the bench. Nothing good is going to happen. I don't care of biid shit himself. Gotta get out there.
JJ for the love of God. Hit a fucking shot.
A flicker of power from Embiid
They don't always need to score 120. KEEP PLAYING THAT CHAMPIONSHIP DEFENSE!!!
Put that mother fucker on a two day juice cleanse.
Brett looking intense. No smiles.
